assertions.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY price DESC

WITH ranked AS (SELECT name, category, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS nr FROM products) SELECT name, category, price FROM ranked WHERE nr = 1 ORDER BY category
SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name HAVING SUM(o.quantity) >= 4 ORDER BY c.name
